name: timeflow
description: TimeFlow - sistema web de monitoreo y registro de actividad de trabajadores remotos

scripts.infra:reset: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml --env-file .env down -v && docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml --env-file .env up -d
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run infra:up && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.infra:tools: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml --env-file .env --profile tools up -d adminer
